Telephone Manager Initialization Functions

Working With a Telephone Tool

This section describes the functions you can use to examine specific details about a telephone tool, determine which Telephone Manager functions it supports, and access special switch features not supported by the Telephone Manager functions. Although the Telephone Manager provides functions for accessing the features of most telephone terminals, you may need to use these functions to access the special capabilities offered by some telephone tools.
